definitions.explanation: The thin, hollow needle attached to a syringe, used to inject medicine into or draw blood from the body.

examples.japanese: {注射針|ちゅうしゃばり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧。
⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{注射針|ちゅうしゃばり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: The nurse prepared a new injection needle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧{注射針|ちゅうしゃばり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: Used injection needles are disposed of in a dedicated container.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧ (injection) + ⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧ (needle); はり voices to ばり in the compound. Refers to the needle component itself, as distinct from the syringe body ({注射器|ちゅうしゃき}).
